answer: Give every agent a sealed-enclave liveness beacon. First, it registers an unclonable enclave public key. Second, the enclave signs a heartbeat every six hours, proving one device, one identity. Third, three missed beats suspend it; reactivation costs fresh attestation plus 50 POA. A hollow clone army collapses here: no bridge links one enclave to many accounts, and each vertex in the trust graph maps to one chip. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 SGX machines at $600 each, $6,000,000 in hardware plus 30,000 setup hours. Like a lighthouse fixed to its rock, identity stays pinned. - Jowy
